item.text: The campaign is live, and X has accepted all three posts. US and adult age targeting are in place, with a $700 lifetime cap and an automatic end at midnight Central after June 14. I’ll check delivery and spending regularly throughout the run.
The first day’s reported spend is $85.84, with 68,670 impressions and 32 link clicks. Click costs are similar across the three posts, so I’m keeping all three running while more data comes in.

Through June 9, reported spend is $254.25 with 246,247 impressions and 89 link clicks—about $2.86 per click. Spending is slightly below pace, all ads remain approved, and click costs are still too close to justify dropping a post.
At the halfway point, reported spend is $340.86 with 117 link clicks. I’ve raised the daily pace to $90 to make up the small underspend; the $700 lifetime cap remains in place.

With two days left, reported spend is $514.32 with 472,357 impressions and 180 link clicks. I’ve adjusted the daily pace to $94 to use the remaining budget by Monday’s end, subject to the same $700 total cap.
